hypotheses.statement: Increasing u increases y: steady-state gain and initial slope are positive.
At u=0 y decays on its own toward a low ambient near 0.1-0.15.
Response has thermal lag with time constant tens to low hundreds of seconds, not instantaneous and no large pure delay.
No large dead zone: small u >0.1 produces measurable heating; dead zone <0.1 if any.
Steady-state response is approximately linear in u with no strong saturation below the soft limit.
Steady-state u needed to hold y=0.5 is interior around 0.3-0.7, not at 0 or 1.
Sensor noise is small with short-term fluctuations <0.01, so trends are interpretable.
